overview: Saanich counted 117,735 residents in the 2021 Census, up 3.1 percent from 114,148 in 2016, making it the largest municipality on Vancouver Island. The median household income was $93,000 in 2020, and 48,048 occupied dwellings spread across 103.59 square kilometres.

The University of Victoria, Camosun College and a growing technology sector shape the local economy. A business here serves affluent established households, a large student population and a wide spread of distinct neighbourhoods, often while competing with downtown Victoria.
